sources.title: jiaheguo521/relu-clip · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Frozen CLIP image encoders distilled into small ReLU/ReLU6 + BatchNorm CNNs that quantise to int8 and run as a single graph on low-power edge accelerators, whose operator coverage is strongest for convolutional networks.
